home.title: USAJUSHO
home.description: A US-to-Japan package forwarding service. Get your own US address and shop US online stores from Japan.

hero.headline: Your own US address for shopping from Japan.
hero.description: USAJUSHO gives you a dedicated US address. Check every package by photo, then consolidate shipments to save on shipping.
hero.trustNote: Signup is free — you're only charged when you actually ship.

journey.title: How your package gets to you
journey.description: From signup to delivery in Japan, USAJUSHO supports the whole process.
journey.step1Description: Sign up and receive your own dedicated US address immediately.
journey.step2Description: Order from Amazon and other US online stores using that address.
journey.step3Description: Our warehouse receives your package, checks its contents, and photographs it.
journey.step4Description: Review your packages, choose consolidation and add-on services, and create the commercial invoice.
journey.step5Description: USAJUSHO ships to Japan and provides a tracking number.
journey.step6Description: Your package arrives at the Japan address you specify.

address.title: Your own dedicated US address
address.description: As soon as you sign up, you get your own address inside a USAJUSHO warehouse — ready to use as the shipping address at any US online store.
address.point1: Issued immediately after signup, no extra fee
address.point2: Consolidate orders from multiple stores at one address
address.point3: Copy your address anytime from your dashboard

inspection.title: Check every arrival by photo
inspection.description: When a package arrives at our warehouse, we photograph the exterior and, when needed, the contents. Review the photos anytime from your dashboard before deciding what's next.
inspection.exteriorAlt: Warehouse staff photographing a package's exterior and shipping label on arrival
inspection.interiorAlt: An opened package with its contents inspected and checked against the order

consolidation.title: Consolidate to save on shipping
consolidation.description: Combine multiple orders into a single shipment to cut shipping costs well below sending each one separately. Repackaging is also available to remove unneeded boxes and paperwork.
consolidation.exampleNote: Savings vary depending on box size and weight.
consolidation.flowAlt: Three separate packages combined into a single consolidated shipment

addons.title: Add only the services you need
addons.description: From inspection to packaging to insurance, choose exactly the services that fit your package.
addons.item1Description: A closer look at your item's condition.
addons.item3Description: Remove packing slips and price tags before shipping.
addons.item4Description: We hold your package until the rest arrive.
addons.item5Description: Coverage in case something goes wrong in transit.
addons.footnote: Full pricing details are available on your dashboard after logging in.

calculator.title: Calculate your shipping cost now
calculator.description: Enter your package weight to see an estimated shipping cost to Japan right away.
calculator.dimensionsHint: Adding dimensions gives a more accurate estimate using dimensional weight (L x W x H / 6000). Max 50kg per box, max 260cm (L+W+H combined), max length 200cm.
calculator.unavailable: Enter a weight to see an estimated cost.
calculator.disclaimer: * Actual shipping cost depends on package size, weight, and any add-on services selected. See your commercial invoice on the dashboard for the final amount.
calculator.overweightContact: For packages over 50kg, please contact support for a custom quote.

tracking.title: Track it from shipment to delivery
tracking.description: Once shipped, you'll get a tracking number and can check delivery status anytime from your dashboard.
tracking.exampleStatus: Handed off to Japan delivery carrier
tracking.exampleNote: Delivery typically takes a few days to about a week after shipping.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1Question: How do I get a US address?
faq.q1Answer: As soon as you complete free signup, your own dedicated US address is issued immediately.
faq.q2Question: When am I charged for shipping?
faq.q2Answer: Only when you actually ship a package to Japan. Signup and using the address itself are free.
faq.q3Answer: Combining multiple packages into a single shipment, which costs less than shipping each one separately.
faq.q4Question: Do I need a commercial invoice?
faq.q4Answer: Yes — it's required for every international shipment. You can create one easily from your dashboard, and our staff can also prepare it on your behalf if needed.

purchaseAgency.headline: Can't buy it from Japan? We'll buy it for you.
purchaseAgency.description: Tell us the product you want from any US store, and USAJUSHO will purchase it on your behalf, inspect it, and ship it to Japan through our usual forwarding service.
purchaseAgency.stepsDescription: From request to delivery, USAJUSHO handles every step.
purchaseAgency.step1Description: Share a product URL and/or a description (name, options, quantity, budget) from your dashboard.
purchaseAgency.step2Description: Our team reviews your request and sends back the item price plus our service fee.
purchaseAgency.step3Description: Approve the quote and pay by credit card through our secure Stripe checkout.
purchaseAgency.step4Description: Once payment is confirmed, we buy the product on your behalf, even from US-only sellers.
purchaseAgency.step5Description: The item arrives at our US warehouse, where it is inspected, photographed, and ready for consolidation like any other package.
purchaseAgency.step6Description: Your purchased item ships to Japan together with the rest of your packages.
purchaseAgency.benefitsDescription: Shop any US store, even ones that won't ship internationally or accept your card.
purchaseAgency.benefit1Description: Many US stores reject international cards. We pay with a US-based card so you don't have to worry about declined payments.
purchaseAgency.benefit2Description: Just send us a product link or description in Japanese - we'll handle all communication with the seller in English.
purchaseAgency.benefit3Description: Some retailers block orders from overseas addresses entirely. Since we order using a US address, this is never a problem.
purchaseAgency.benefit4Description: A flat fee plus a small percentage of the item price - clearly shown in your quote before you pay, no hidden costs.
purchaseAgency.finalCtaTitle: Ready to get something we can't buy in Japan?
purchaseAgency.finalCtaDescription: Sign up for a free USAJUSHO account and submit your first purchase request in minutes.
